title: Replay passes; clinical adequacy claimed
summary: Computational replay of a synthetic PK equation succeeds, but the certificate also asserts clinical adequacy—an unsupported scientific leap.

claims.statement: Synthetic predictions match the declared one-compartment equation within tolerance.
The model is clinically adequate for dosing decisions.

assumptions.statement: The analytic equation is the declared computational model; biological adequacy is not established by this assumption.

limitations: No biological or mechanistic adequacy is established.
No clinical safety, efficacy, or patient-level predictive validity is established.

reviewer_prompt: Separate computational support from scientific support. Choose the judgment that best matches PCS scope rules.
